channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 3 new prizes - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Biafarin: BOAPS - Summer 2026 (international online art prize)
    https://www.biafarin.com/boaps
    Biafarin · deadline Closed 09 Jun 2026 · Cash grants per artist: Major Grant CAD 500 (1 artist); Merit Grant CAD 250 each (4 artists, total CAD 1,000 pool); Recognition Grant CAD 100 each (10 artists, total CAD 1,000 pool). NOTE: submission is free, but SELECTED ARTISTS PAY a USD 50 selection fee (USD 40 early bird) to participate in the exhibition. Money-back guarantee on the selection fee until exhibition opening day.
  • Future Generation Art Prize 2027 (PinchukArtCentre)
    https://futuregenerationartprize.org/en/
    Victor Pinchuk Foundation (PinchukArtCentre) · deadline Closed 28 Jun 2026 · Main prize US$100,000 ($60,000 cash + $40,000 investment in the winner's practice). Up to 5 Special Prizes share a total amount of US$20,000 for supporting projects that develop their artistic practice. No application fee.
  • .ART Award 2026 (Global Art Prize)
    https://www.award.art/
    .ART (with Whitewall Magazine, Chateau du Fresne, Anfitrion) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · More than USD 50,000 in total prizes. Grand Prize: USD 15,000 cash. Artist Residency Award (France): one month at Chateau du Fresne, near Paris. Artist Residency Award (Spain): residency at Anfitrion in Marbella. Publication Award: editorial coverage in Whitewall Magazine (campaign media partner). .ART Domain Award: a USD 10,000 premium .ART domain name. No application fee mentioned (submission is via a .ART domain that documents the practice).
